coverageContext: UK Biobank research model for reported hearing difficulty/problems, not measured audiometric thresholds or a specific sensorineural diagnosis. Partial correlations are small and vary across ancestry groups; several intervals include zero. GA computes the genetic component, not the covariate-adjusted study prediction. Not a current hearing test, hearing-aid recommendation or calibrated personal probability.

Han Chinese TPMI research model with broad psoriasis/related-skin-condition training codes and a psoriatic-arthropathy evaluation of 167 cases. Published AUROC includes sex, age, array and ancestry covariates; GA computes only the genetic component. EUR ranks are withheld. Not a psoriasis-to-arthritis progression probability, joint-damage measurement, diagnosis or medication guide.

Han Chinese TPMI research model evaluated in 654 cases under a combined migraine/cluster-headache code definition. Reported performance includes sex, age, array and ancestry covariates, not GA genetics alone. EUR ranks are withheld. Not an aura/subtype classification, attack forecast, pain-severity measure, diagnosis or treatment recommendation.
